issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וּמִלְאוּ יָדוֹ' (literally 'and they shall fill its hand' or 'and they shall consecrate it') is an idiom meaning 'to ordain/consecrate' (fill the hand), not 'dâng tay mình' ('offer their hand'). The Vietnamese rendering changes the meaning from consecrating the altar to offering one's hand.
